project_context.theme: Historic cultural and sporting legacy - Editorial feel
project_context.vibe: Cinematic, monumental, luxury performance (E1 Archetype: Luxury & The Performance Pro)

headings.font: Oswald, Bebas Neue, or Cabinet Grotesk (DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, or generic sans for headings)
headings.usage: Massive typographic storytelling (e.g., text-[10vw] or text-8xl+ for massive stats like '7', '103')
headings.guidance: Headings must break the grid. Let huge numbers overlap slightly with image or other text.

body.font: Inter, IBM Plex Sans, or similar geometric sans
body.style: tracking-wide, text-sm to text-base, text-neutral-400, leading-relaxed
body.usage: Data labels, story text, metadata, overlines

colors.background: Deepest Obsidian (#050505) - NEVER use flat generic grays. Must feel like a premium dark room.
colors.guidance: Color is Function and Emotion. The UI should be almost entirely monochrome (Obsidian/White), using the team colors strictly as vivid kinetic accents (e.g., a 1px glowing line, a text gradient on a specific stat, or a hover state glow). Do not flood the screen with team colors.

grids_and_layouts.overall_strategy: The Editorial Monolith. Avoid standard symmetrical dashboards, equal-sized grid cards, or 'Bootstrap' columns. Use extreme asymmetry and optical alignment.
grids_and_layouts.desktop_1920x800: Two-column asymmetrical split. Left: massive typographic storytelling and dynamic stats overlapping on a dark void. Right: 100vh height cinematic portrait image taking exactly 45% of the viewport width. Leave massive negative space (gap-24 to gap-32) between stats clusters.
grids_and_layouts.mobile_390x844: Vertical stack. Image fixed at top 50vh with a hard bottom gradient fade (mask-image) into absolute black. Stats and typography scroll over the faded portion of the image. Text aligned left, never centered.

components.back_to_circuit_button: Keep existing logic and position. Style as a premium glassmorphic pill: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/10 border border-white/20, text-white, uppercase, tracking-wider, text-xs. Must remain at z-50 to ensure compatibility with overlays.
components.stats_block: No cards. Flat on the background. A massive number (text-8xl+) paired tightly with a tracking-wide label. Use 1px left borders in team colors to denote which team the stat belongs to.

media.image_treatment: Use the provided portrait. Apply a high-contrast treatment. On desktop, use a CSS mask-image (linear-gradient) on the left edge so the image fades seamlessly into the #050505 background. The hero image is a premium asset—let it breathe, do NOT cover the face with heavy dark overlays, only use gradients where text MUST sit.

portrait.description: Authentic portrait image to be used as the hero/background anchor for the legacy page.

motion.entrance: Cinematic and weighty. 1.5s slow ease-out scale on the image (from 1.05 to 1). Staggered fade-up (Y: 30px -> 0, opacity 0 -> 1) on the typographic stats, staggered by 0.1s. Elements should feel heavy and deliberate.
motion.interactions: Hover states on data points should slightly dim siblings (opacity 50%) and reveal a team-colored subtle glow or translation (x: 4px) on the hovered item.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all stat numbers and labels meet 4.5:1 against the #050505 background.
accessibility.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='back-to-circuit-btn', data-testid='legacy-stat-value').

instructions_to_main_agent: Modify ONLY the Legacy chapter component (.js files).
Keep the overlay mechanics (Silverstone camera, back to circuit) fully intact without altering their logical flow.
Do NOT turn the stats into a generic table or equal-sized grid. Use massive typographic numbers combined with small overlines.
Apply 'mask-image' fading to the portrait to blend it seamlessly into the dark UI.
Map the team colors (Ferrari red, Mercedes cyan, McLaren papaya) dynamically to the specific stats/era they represent.
Enforce extreme negative space. Cramped designs kill the luxury editorial vibe.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) instead of flat transparent colors.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Always specify properties to prevent breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS. Respect human reading flow.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped) with interaction animations and explicit hover/focus states.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
